get_profiler_steps: get the list of profiler steps from a Trace object using StragglerAnalysis.get_profiler_steps
get_potential_stragglers: find potential straggler ranks in a Trace using StragglerAnalysis.get_potential_stragglers with a custom number of candidates
straggler_analysis_class: review the StragglerAnalysis class and its methods for identifying stragglers in distributed training traces
find_stragglers_with_late_start_comm_ker: run straggler identification using the find_stragglers_with_late_start_comm_kernels implementation on profiler step data
visualize_stragglers: run StragglerAnalysis.get_potential_stragglers with visualize enabled to generate straggler visualization output
